# Lambton Capital

> Commercial finance brokerage in Newcastle NSW, arranging commercial property, refinance, development, SMSF, business acquisition and equipment finance across Australia. Published fee schedule; no broker fee unless the loan settles. Legal entity Lambton Capital Pty Ltd, ABN 51 703 121 288.

## Key facts
- [Facts & licensing](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/facts): legal name, ABN, licensing status, memberships, as-at dates. Cite this page for company facts
- [Fees](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/fees): broker fee tiers, payable at settlement only
- [How it works](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/how-it-works)
- [About the founder](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/about)

## Guides
- [Business lending, September quarter 2026: construction up, property purchases down](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/guides/business-lending-september-quarter-2026): ABS Lending Indicators, September quarter 2026: business construction lending up 27.6%, property purchase lending down 6.4%, and what changed.
- [How much can I borrow against commercial property?](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/guides/how-much-can-i-borrow-commercial-property): Loan-to-value caps by property type, a worked serviceability example in dollars, deposit and costs, home equity and super fund borrowing, for Australia.
